title: UART
summary: UART terminal with baud controls, text/hex tools and RX captures.
description:
UART is a serial debugging terminal for Cardputer Zero, with a black interface, neon-red controls and configurable terminal text colors.

Connect through the top CAP header using G14 (TX), G15 (RX) and GND, or use a supported USB serial adapter. Includes baud and framing settings, RX-only mode, ANSI terminal display, text/hex sending, raw RX captures and scrollback.

Operate the app with keys 4–8 or F/X/Z/C navigation. Enter selects actions or starts terminal typing. Tap Esc to return to controls; hold Esc to exit.

UART signals are fixed at 3.3V TTL. Separate header and Grove 5V power outputs require confirmation before enabling. Hardware and drivers determine supported serial speeds and formats.
